title: Visiting Fellow in Dermatologic Laser Surgery
inst: Faculty of Medicine Ramathibodi Hospital, Mahidol University
Department: Division of Dermatology (via International Relations Section)
Duration: Programme fee quoted per 1 month (4 weeks); sessions start the first or third week of each month
Start: First or third week of every month except April
Deadline: Apply at least three months before the intended start date
Eligibility: Dermatologist with at least 10 months of training in general dermatology from an accredited institution; communicative English (TOEFL/IELTS score required); recommendation letter, CV, cover letter, dermatology certificate/diploma
International applicants: Yes - programme run by the International Relations Section for overseas dermatologists
Application method: Online application (Google Form) with attached documents; acceptance notified by email from Ramathibodi International Relations
Positions: Two applicants accepted at a time per training session
Funding: Self-funded - tuition 2,000 USD per month, paid by bank transfer within two weeks of acceptance
Visa support: Page states international participants require a Non-Immigrant Education (ED) visa, arranged by the applicant at a Royal Thai Embassy/Consulate; copy required after acceptance
Summary: Short visiting fellowship for dermatologists covering laser and light systems and procedures such as botulinum toxin, fillers, grafts, hair transplantation, peels and photodynamic therapy through case discussion, live demonstration and supervised practice.
